h1.speaker: hana
h1.text: Mister samurai! Have you seen my papa's boat? It went out the morning the waves turned black.

h2.speaker: hana
h2.text: Lady Kagami holds the black water back every night. I bring her rice balls. She's so tired now...

choices.text: I'll look for him. Here - eat something first. (10 gold)
I'll keep an eye out for him.
I don't have time for this.

h_kind.speaker: hana
h_kind.text: You're nice. Not like the fox-man. Papa gave me this - he said it opens the way home, wherever home is. Maybe you need it more than me.

h_key.speaker: narrator
h_key.text: Hana's key - a child's kindness - is warm in your hand.

h_ask.speaker: hana
h_ask.text: Papa's name is Jun. He has a scar on his chin and he sings really badly. Old Sabu at the net store knows every boat on the shore. Ask him? Please?

h_cruel.speaker: narrator
h_cruel.text: She steps aside without a word. She is trying very hard not to cry.

after_kind.speaker: hana
after_kind.text: Did Old Sabu know anything? His net store is past the big square, to the south-west. Papa says Sabu knows where every boat sleeps.

ret1.speaker: hana
ret1.text: That's... that's Papa's charm. He carved my name on it. Where is he? Where's Papa?

choices.text: He didn't make it back, Hana. But he held on to this until the end.
He's still out past the black water. He sent this so you'd know he's coming.

ret_truth2.speaker: narrator
ret_truth2.text: She doesn't cry. She holds the charm against her chest, the way he must have.

ret_truth3.speaker: hana
ret_truth3.text: These are Lady Kagami's rice balls. She made them for Papa's trips. He'd want you to have them. ...Thank you for telling me.

ret_lie.speaker: hana
ret_lie.text: I knew it! I'll wait right here for him. Take these - Lady Kagami's rice balls. For the long walk!

after_return.speaker: hana
after_return.text: I'm wearing the charm now. Lady Kagami says the tide keeps what it loves. I think it loved Papa.

epi1.speaker: narrator
epi1.text: Without its warden, the sea keeps rising. Black water laps at the village steps.

epi2.speaker: hana
epi2.text: Lady Kagami isn't standing in the surf anymore. The water won't stop. ...Did you do that?

choices.text: I did. And I'm going to make it right. I promise.

epi_vow.speaker: hana
epi_vow.text: Then take Papa's spear. He said a promise needs something to hold it up. Bring the light back, samurai. I'll be watching the water.

epi_vow2.speaker: narrator
epi_vow2.text: Something steadies in you. A promise is a kind of light - one nobody can take from you.

epi_cold2.speaker: narrator
epi_cold2.text: She sits at the edge of the steps, holding something small on a string, and watches the water climb.

after_vow.speaker: hana
after_vow.text: The water's still black. But you promised. So I'm not scared.

after_all.speaker: narrator
after_all.text: Hana watches the black water and doesn't turn around.

spurned_post.speaker: narrator
spurned_post.text: Hana sits on the steps, watching the black water climb past the second stair. She doesn't look up.
